Median organization age

Source: R/count-metrics.R
get_median_age.Rd

Median years since the IRS ruling that granted exemption, among the organizations in each market.

Usage

get_median_age(
  df,
  geography = "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS",
  subsector = "NTEEV2",
  year = "TAXYEAR",
  ruling = "RULING_YEAR"
)

Arguments

df

A data frame with one row per organization-year.

geography

Name of the column that identifies the market's geography, such as "CENSUS_CBSA_FIPS" or "COUNTY_FIPS".

subsector

Name of the column that identifies the subsector. When it is "NTEEV2", the first three characters (the major group) are used.

year

Name of the column that identifies the year, such as "TAXYEAR".

ruling

Name of the ruling-year column.

Value

A tibble with GEO, SUB, YEAR, N_AGE (organizations with a valid ruling year) and MEDIAN_AGE. Ruling years after the tax year are treated as missing.

Examples

a <- get_median_age( npo_panel_sample, geography = "COUNTY_FIPS",
                     year = "TAXYEAR", ruling = "ORG_RULING_YEAR" )
head( a[ a$SUB == "ALL", ] )
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   GEO   SUB    YEAR N_AGE MEDIAN_AGE
#>   <chr> <chr> <int> <int>      <dbl>
#> 1 50001 ALL    2015   118         22
#> 2 50001 ALL    2016   119         21
#> 3 50001 ALL    2017   119         22
#> 4 50001 ALL    2018   120         23
#> 5 50001 ALL    2019   126         23
#> 6 50003 ALL    2015   116         22
